scope: Classic CANopen CiA 301 / examples; source anchors and assumptions

claims.claim: PDO uses producer/consumer semantics; classic CAN data is at most 8 bytes.
Mapping entry has index in bits 31–16, subindex in 15–8 and bit length in 7–0.
claims.notes: Map length 64 bits in the illustrated example

claims.claim: 0x606C and 0x6064 are velocity and position actual values, while 0x6041 is statusword.
claims.locator: CiA 402 device profile; object names backed by existing P0 verification ledger
claims.notes: Device engineering units and mappability are vendor-dependent

claims.claim: Type 0 synchronous acyclic, 1–240 synchronous cyclic, 254/255 asynchronous event-driven.
claims.notes: Legacy RTR exceptions not universally supported

claims.claim: 0x1800:03 inhibit time is 100us units, :05 event timer ms, :06 SYNC start value.
Two 32-bit entries encode as 0x606C0020 and 0x60640020; 1000/-2000 encode 8 bytes LE.
50 nodes x 100 frames/s x 111 bits / 500000bit/s = 111% minimum load.
claims.notes: Excludes bit stuffing, error frames, retry and all other traffic
